evals.prompt: We just shipped the rolling trivia burst feature — commissioners can now set a maxBurstQuestions value and trivia fires automatically between picks. Update the guides.
evals.expected_output: Commissioner guide updated with burst trivia settings documentation. User guide updated to explain trivia between picks. Scoring page trivia section verified. Stale terminology check passes.
expectations: The commissioner guide (/guide/commissioner) mentions maxBurstQuestions or burst trivia settings
The user guide (/guide/user) explains that trivia questions appear between draft picks
The scoring page trivia section is verified or updated if needed
A summary of changes is provided at the end
No references to 'War Room' or 'Chat' remain in updated files

evals.prompt: Sync the guides — I think they're behind after the last few sessions.
evals.expected_output: Skill reads git log to detect recent changes, identifies which guide sections are stale, and updates only the affected sections. Provides a summary showing what was changed and what was already current.
expectations: Git log is read to detect recent feature changes
At least one guide file is read before any edits are made
Only sections related to actual changes are modified
A structured summary is provided listing each guide file and what happened

evals.expected_output: All references to 'Chat' replaced with 'Live Feed' across guide pages. Description updated to explain one-way notification stream. Commissioner guide updated if chat moderation was documented.
expectations: The word 'Chat' is replaced with 'Live Feed' in guide content
The description of Live Feed explains it's a one-way system notification stream
A grep or search is run to find all instances of stale 'Chat' terminology
A summary of terminology fixes is provided with count
